constructs.definition_and_components:
Inherited parental or offspring liability and stable shared familial background.
Includes: Shared family background; parental and offspring inherited liability; drug-metabolism genotype as a candidate mechanistic component.
constructs.timing_and_boundaries: Antecedent family background; genotype established by conception. A sibling comparison is a control strategy, not a measured node. Later household changes belong elsewhere.
constructs.grading_role: B1 required; sets A and B

constructs.definition_and_components:
Maternal demographic and family characteristics, with child sex treated as a distinct component.
Includes: Maternal age; household or partner structure; social-group and migration context; child sex.
constructs.timing_and_boundaries: Pregnancy-relevant antecedent characteristics. Child sex alone does not represent maternal or family context. Effects involving one component are not assumed for all components.
constructs.grading_role: B3 required; sets A and B

constructs.definition_and_components:
Socioeconomic resources and attainment established before the target exposure.
Includes: Completed education; material resources; income; employment.
constructs.timing_and_boundaries: Use pre-exposure measures. Post-treatment or post-child-outcome changes fall outside this definition.
constructs.grading_role: B3 required; sets A and B

constructs.definition_and_components:
Geographical setting and calendar context relevant to the target pregnancy.
Includes: Pre-exposure residence or geographical context; pregnancy or exposure calendar period.
constructs.timing_and_boundaries: Distinguish residence from healthcare-site choice and sample composition. Calendar time is an index; childhood residence is not substituted for pregnancy context.
constructs.grading_role: B3 required; sets A and B

constructs.definition_and_components:
Established maternal neurodevelopmental or psychiatric conditions and history.
Includes: Maternal neurodevelopmental background; maternal psychiatric-health background.
constructs.timing_and_boundaries: Conditions precede the medication use they may influence. Excludes reactions to the child's outcome and transient post-dose symptoms; onset and recording dates may differ.
constructs.grading_role: B1 required; sets A and B

constructs.node_and_construct:
C06
Maternal physical and metabolic health
constructs.definition_and_components:
Pre-existing maternal physical or metabolic disease and antecedent adiposity.
Includes: Chronic physical or metabolic conditions; pre-exposure BMI or adiposity.
constructs.timing_and_boundaries: Disease or adiposity precedes target exposure. Current-pregnancy complications belong to C13; newly drug-induced disease is outside this established-health construct.
constructs.grading_role: B2 required; sets A and B

constructs.definition_and_components:
Maternal symptoms and indications present before target medication use.
Includes: Infection; fever; pain; headache or migraine.
constructs.timing_and_boundaries: Specify the indication and its timing. Excludes symptom relief and new symptoms after exposure; ordering relative to healthcare use or other treatment is not universal.
constructs.grading_role: B2 required; sets A and B

constructs.node_and_construct:
C08
Reproductive and prior obstetric history
constructs.definition_and_components:
Completed reproductive and obstetric history before the target pregnancy.
Includes: Parity; previous pregnancies; prior adverse obstetric outcomes.
constructs.timing_and_boundaries: Excludes complications and events of the current pregnancy. Historical circumstances are distinguished from current age and household measures.
constructs.grading_role: Not graded in B1–B3; not in either minimal set

constructs.node_and_construct:
C09
Psychosocial conditions and health behaviors
constructs.definition_and_components:
Maternal psychosocial conditions and health behaviours preceding target exposure.
Includes: Smoking; alcohol use; other substance use; psychosocial stress.
constructs.timing_and_boundaries: Excludes post-exposure behaviour changes and reactions to the child's outcome. Healthcare literacy and general care preferences are not interchangeable with these components.
constructs.grading_role: Additional B3 coverage; required in set B

constructs.node_and_construct:
C10
Maternal healthcare seeking and use
constructs.definition_and_components:
Actual maternal healthcare seeking and contacts before target exposure.
Includes: Preventive and symptom-driven maternal contacts; pregnancy-relevant prior healthcare use.
constructs.timing_and_boundaries: Excludes post-exposure and child diagnostic contacts. Access, income, health literacy and latent care propensity are distinct. Pregnancy-wide utilisation alone does not establish pre-exposure coverage.

constructs.definition_and_components:
Other medications and treatments used before target exposure.
Includes: Other drug classes; other treatments, with the specific class or treatment identified.
constructs.timing_and_boundaries: Excludes treatments initiated after target exposure or the child's diagnosis. Treatment episodes must remain temporally consistent; no universal order relative to C07 or C10 is assumed.
constructs.grading_role: B2 required; sets A and B

constructs.definition_and_components:
Actual environmental or occupational agents relevant to maternal exposure.
Includes: Pollutants; lead; pesticides; relevant physical agents; other specified environmental or occupational exposures.
constructs.timing_and_boundaries: Maternal preconception or prenatal exposure history. Job class, residence, income and workplace culture alone do not identify an actual agent. Postnatal child exposure is separate.
constructs.grading_role: Additional B3 coverage; required in set B

constructs.node_and_construct:
C13
Current-pregnancy obstetric and perinatal health
constructs.definition_and_components:
Obstetric and perinatal conditions of the current pregnancy, comprising components with different temporal positions.
Includes: Pregnancy complications before or after exposure; gestational age at delivery; birth weight; delivery mode.
constructs.timing_and_boundaries: For set B, require a controlled obstetric condition documented before the selected exposure window and compatible with the graph’s antecedent component. Delivery/neonatal outcomes do not qualify. Pregnancy-wide complications without onset ordering remain unresolved.
constructs.grading_role: Not graded in B1–B3. Set B requires confirmed pre-exposure C13 coverage.

constructs.definition_and_components:
Actual infant feeding and breastfeeding practices during a specified early postnatal period.
Includes: Infant feeding status; breastfeeding in the same defined infant window; relevant duration or change.
constructs.timing_and_boundaries: After delivery and before the selected later endpoint. May overlap early health and developmental manifestations; no universal order relative to C15 or C16 is assumed.
constructs.grading_role: B4 exclusion when actually conditioned on

constructs.node_and_construct:
C15
Early childhood physical and immune health
constructs.definition_and_components:
Early childhood physical illness, immune-related conditions and relevant biological states.
Includes: Physical-health events; infection; atopic or immune-health measures; microbiome-related measures as a distinct component.
constructs.timing_and_boundaries: After birth and before the selected later endpoint. Distinguish actual health from detection or healthcare use; minor infections are not interchangeable with severe CNS injury.

constructs.node_and_construct:
C16
Early neurodevelopmental and regulatory phenotypes
constructs.definition_and_components:
Early developmental or regulatory manifestations distinct from the selected later outcome.
Includes: Early neurodevelopmental manifestations; early regulatory or behavioural phenotypes.
constructs.timing_and_boundaries: After birth and before a separate later endpoint. If the measure is itself the selected endpoint, it belongs to Y. Symptom onset and recognition may differ.
constructs.grading_role: B4 exclusion when actually conditioned on

constructs.node_and_construct:
C17
Biological and pharmacological response processes
constructs.definition_and_components:
Candidate biological or pharmacological responses following target prenatal exposure.
Includes: Oxidative response; hormonal signalling; epigenetic response; placental-function response.
constructs.timing_and_boundaries: Post-exposure responses during pregnancy. Excludes baseline biological states and effects on later treatment episodes. Components are hypothetical, non-exhaustive mechanisms requiring supporting evidence.
constructs.grading_role: B4 exclusion when actually conditioned on
